page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6t.26xlarge is a high-density, compute-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. Powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz, this instance provisions 104 dedicated vCPUs alongside 192 GB of system RAM. The resulting memory density is approximately 1.85 GB per vCPU, placing it firmly in the compute-optimized category where processing power takes precedence over large memory allocations.

Networking capabilities feature a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps, providing high throughput for distributed computing nodes and continuous data transfer tasks. The instance does not include local disk storage, requiring network-attached block storage for persistent or temporary file execution. Additionally, no complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware accelerators are attached to this configuration.

By providing a high allocation of 104 dedicated compute cores alongside 32 Gbps network throughput, this instance delivers strong resource efficiency for highly parallelized processing tasks that do not demand extensive memory footprints or local drives. Appropriate workloads include batch data processing, distributed compute jobs, CPU-bound scientific simulations, financial modeling, and web application servers requiring high execution density.
